So, what's the point of all this? I don't know... Maybe my story will inspire someone who's about to give up hope to reconsider it

Everyone's career journey is different. Mine was not straight forward, it was rough, but I'm glad I pushed through. Moral of the story is, you got this 💙

- A year later in 2022 got to work on God of War Ragnarok with an incredible team, a serious dream come true
- Never, ever imagined I'd get to work on a game that would do so well with so many accolades for audio
- A year after that, I got my current job at SMS, and it's been a whirlwind ever since

- I was stunned when they made me an offer. Like... me? They picked me? What?
- First project there was Horizon Forbidden West, made tools instead of design, but it helped the team who was/is incredible and incredibly welcoming

- Being there for so long made me feel vulnerable. It felt like everything I had learned was limited because I was self taught
- In 2021 the writing was on the wall, I had to move on
- There was an opening at PlayStation, I went for it with very very very low expectations

- 11 years later, now with four more kids. So many amazing memories & opportunities. Shipped 16 games, wrote hours of music
- Pandemic hit... that was devastating for my kid's mental health, things are getting better but it's been rough...

- Moved my new family from LA to Irvine, started in Jan 2010
- Hit the ground running with a vertical slice due at the end of the first month. Immediately shifted to work on New Vegas
- 3 years later my mom passed away, 2 years later my step dad passed away too

- Drove myself home, slept for 3 hours, woke up feeling terrible and drove 50 miles to my interview
- Pretending everything was great during the interview was rough, but I made it through
- Went out to my car in the parking lot and slept
- 3 weeks later, I got the job

- The night before the second interview, which was 2 pm the next day, I had very bad stomach flu symptoms. Room was spinning, heart was racing, was definitely dehydrated
- Drove myself to the ER at 3 am, after a 3 hour wait they gave me an IV

- Out of work again, even with a bit more experience, I got nothing but rejection
- Saw an opening at Obsidian, applied and was given a test
- Sent in the test and was given a chance at a second interview

- Continued applying, continued networking, continued to get rejected 
- Finally, desperate for work,  got a contract job at Pandemic Studios mid 2009
- Shipped my first major game 9 months later, and a month later the studio closed down

- A year later the studio fell on hard times, contracts were canceled, my daughter was due any day, I had no demo reel to show for my "big break"
- Jobless for 4 months, with a new child, got side work as a composer assistant for TV. Hours were brutal, but the money was decent, if inconsistent

- Applied to job after job to break into game audio, got rejection after rejection. There were no entry level openings
- Got my big break as a sound desinger at a game startup in summer 2007
- Things were looking up, wife was pregnant with our first child. Was starting to pay down debt

- Finally graduated in 2007, Suma Cum Laude, after 10 years in school
- Tried to break into game composition, realized I couldn't compete
- Tried to network. Some people were so awesome, some were highly, highly toxic (thank goodness the game audio community is so welcoming today)

- Got married a year into being in school. Fell on difficult financial times, dropped out of school to get a job in 3D film post production. Was there 6 months
- The place closed down, I went back to school to finish juggling an on campus job in IT and a 15 mile, 2-3 hr commute each way
- Was told at my UCLA audition that I got in. Only a handful were admitted for composition

- I doubled down. Woke up every morning at 5 to write music, practice guitar. Joined a guitar quartet. We performed. Worked a part time job at a coffee shop. Went to 3 separate campuses across LA to finish my AA degree
- Reapplied to UCLA & a bunch of other schools. Was accepted to all with grants

- Inspired, I went back to school, earned straight A's. Found fantastic teachers in recording, theory, guitar. Got an internship
- Determined to transfer to UCLA, was rejected at the audition. Also rejected from all schools I applied to
- I felt like a failure. But I refused to allow it to define me

Everyone's career journey is different. Here's my 🧵

- Barely graduated high school
- Went to community college after. Got D's & F's
- Dropped out, got a job at a bank in a call center, met my future wife
- She was a year younger & 1 year away from earning 2 bachelor's degrees. I was 3 years behind

text: Question for audio folks still here. Looking for a sub $200 USB audio interface with a really nice headphone amp that can drive 60+ ohm headphones. Other I/O doesn't matter as much. Does this exist??

So, if game audio is your passion, you should absolutely seek it out. Learn Unreal, learn Wwise, and keep an open mind about how seniority translates across industries. It may take some extra effort on your part to bridge the gap, but you can do it!

8/8

It's just a matter of filling in those knowledge gaps with experience. It may mean that while you're Sr. in the post world, you might be more mid level in the game audio world until you ship a game or two. 

7/8

I would say to not get discouraged though! Audio post skills are absolutely critical for game audio, and are an advantage to you. 

6/8

The reason why is because Seniors are generally looked to for their expertise by the entire team, and are viewed as people who you can give any task to and they would be able to complete it with minimal interaction.

5/8

Similar for production - coordinating and integrating audio efforts with other teams requires a similar understanding of game dev experience. An understanding of the entire game dev pipeline is a must for a Sr. 

4/8

Making games is quite technical and it takes a long while to understand how that all works. It's not only learning Wwise or a middleware, it's also understanding how games work and are designed, and for someone Sr. a lot of that knowledge is expected. 

3/8

Transitioning from post to game audio is absolutely possible, though at a senior level can be trickier. The main challenge is filling in the technical and production side of the knowledge gap.  

2/8

Lilac-breasted Roller (Coracias caudatus) This colourful bird of East & South Africa is 38cm (15in) in length & feeds on insects, amphibians & small vertebrates often hunted from a perch vantage point. Thank you again Barry Leppan for sharing your striking photo of this Roller taken in South Africa.

Chameleon (family Chamaeleonidae) There are 200 species of Chameleon
"While they can blend into their surroundings, chameleons primarily change color to regulate body temperature (darker to absorb heat, lighter to reflect) or to communicate" Info & photo by Ann Warner in Zimbabwe #wildlife #zimbabwe

Rainbow Lorikeet (Trichoglossus moluccanus) This 30cm (12in) long bird is a true native Parrot to Australia. They are extremely colourful & noisy birds. They have also been illegally introduced into New Zealand. Great photo taken by Penelope P. in Australia. 🦜#lorikeet #wildlife #australia #nature

European Pine Marten (Martes martes): 70cm (27.5in). This mammal has retractable claws which enable it to climb trees & run along tree branches in the arboreal habitats of Northern Europe. Cracking photo taken by Suzi Sullivan in the UK. #pinemarten #europeanpinemarten #wildlife #nature

Northern Gannet (Morus bassanus):
youtube.com/shorts/R9oOE... #gannet #nature #northerngannet #wildlife #bird #birds
embedded_title: Northern Gannet. #gannet #northerngannet #wildlife #birds #nature
embedded_description: YouTube video by wildlife.net

text: Scarlet Tanager (Paringa olivacea): This 19cm (7.5in) species is native to North America and into northern South America, it is a seed eating bird. Thank you again Debbie McKenzie for sharing your Splendid photo of a Tanager taken in Anniston, Alabama, USA. #tanager #scarlettanager #wildlife #nature

Atlantic Puffin (Fratercula arctica) This 28cm (11in) seabird is much adored across the Atlantic, breeding from Maine in the USA to Newfoundland in Canada, Iceland, Ireland, Greenland, Norway & the UK. Lovely photo taken by B. McCloudy of Puffins in Scotland #puffin #puffins #wildlife #nature #birds
Palm Tanager & Shining Honeycreepers; Tranquillo Bay, Panama, 2-2-2026
Lovely photo Van! Stewart (from Wildlife.net) 👍
That's Amazing 🌼🌼🌼🐴 Barbara! @bar-b.bsky.social
Although they are appearing earlier, May to June is a peak blooming period that is crucial for pollinators.. 🌼🌼🌼🐝🐝 🦋   🐝

Each single flower in a head known as a floret. Due to their abundance and status as a generalist species, dandelions are among the most vital early spring nectar sources for a wide array of pollinators, which are critical for the pollination of later-flowering plants.

In North America they are considered introduced species. Both species are entirely edible. The common name "dandelion" comes from the French "dent-de-lion," meaning "lion's tooth." Like other members of the Asteraceae family, dandelions feature very small flowers grouped together.

The dandelion (genus Taraxacum) belongs to the Asteraceae family, which includes species commonly known as dandelions, native to Eurasia & North America. However, the two most widespread species globally, T. officinale and T. erythrospermum, were introduced from Europe and now thrive as wildflowers🌼

Just a reminder🌼: Dandelions are a crucial source of early nectar for pollinators. Flowering usually peaks in a few weeks' time, but we are already receiving reports of good numbers of dandelions across the hemisphere. So, if you're mowing, consider leaving a few plants to flower 🐝 #dandelions #bees

European Red Squirrel (Sciurus vulgaris): The Head & Body length of this rodent is 23cm (9in) with its tail adding 20cm (8in). Thank you Johan van der Louw for sharing your photo taken in the Netherlands. #squirrel #redsquirrel #europeanredsquirrel #wildlife #netherlands #nature 🐿️

Red Fox (Vulpes vulpes): This mammal is the largest of the true foxes and is widespread across North America, Europe & Asia, also introduced to Australia. They are omnivorous but feed primarily on small mammals, also taking birds, fish & fruit. 🦊 Photo taken by Pam Agnew in the UK.

#foxoftheday
Greylag Goose (Anser Anser): Lovely photo of a Gosling shared by Karen O'Reilly.. 🐥 #greylag #greylaggoose #goose #gosling #anseranser #nature #wildlife #wildlifephotography #bsky

Sulphur-crested Cockatoo (Cacatua galerita): This large white cockatoo is found in New Guinea, some of Indonesia's islands and Australia. They have done particularly well in suburban areas around some of Australia's cities. Beautiful photo taken by Chris Prince in the Northern Territory, Australia.

Hoverfly (family Surphidae) Of the genus Asarkina this is a small fly with large compound eyes & bright yellow or orange markings that mimic bees or wasps for protection through Batesian mimicry. Photo by Webby Jr taken in South Kalimantan,Indonesia #hoverfly #pollinator #wildlife #indonesia #nature
That's Amazing PJ! @pjpaisel.bsky.social 👍

Azalea (genus Rhododendron): These are flowering shrubs that bloom in the spring (April & May in the Northern Hemisphere, and October & November in the Southern Hemisphere). Their flowers attract pollinators. They are part of the family Ericaceae. Photo taken in Bridgnorth, Shropshire, UK. #azalea

Western Tiger Swallowtail (Papilio rutulus): This butterfly has a fast flight and can frequently be observed hovering over herbal plants to take nectar. Photo by Jay Spring taken in Mission Viejo, California, USA. See more from Jay at: www.springphotos.net #tiger #swallowtail #operationpollinate

Bearded Reedling (Panurus biarmicus): With a range across temperate Europe & Asia, this bird is a wetland specialist. It nests in colonies, normally near swamps, reed beds or marshes. Brilliant photo taken by Paul Nicholls on the Somerset levels in the UK. #tit #bird #beardedreedling #beardedtit
Purple Sunbird. Glorious photo taken by Digvijay Lande in Nagpur, Maharashtra, India. #sunbird #purplesunbird #nagpur #india #wildlife #maharashtra #nature
Thank you Cleo! Neat photo @thinkingtogether.bsky.social 👍
Fantastic Jersey Tiger Michel! ❤️ @michel-forestier.bsky.social

Holly Blue (Celastrina argiolus): 3.4cm (1.3in). This is a butterfly that belongs to the lycaenids or blues family and is native to the Palearctic. A camera phone snap by one of our team shared from Quarndon in Derbyshire, UK. #hollyblue #blue #bluebutterfly #nature #wildlife #quarndon #derbyshire

Yellowhammer (Emberiza citronella) A 16.5cm (6.5in) yellow Bunting species native to Europe & Asia. It's been introduced to the Falkland Islands, South Africa, Australia & NZ, this Bunting feeds on seeds, grain, oats & other plants such as yarrow, Awesome photo by Liz Hendry in Scotland #wildlife

Koala (Phascolarctos cinereus): This wonderful marsupial is not a bear, even if it resembles one. It is native to Australia's southern and eastern coastlines, typically in eucalypt woodlands. Photo taken by Thiago de Paula Oliveira in Australia 🐨 #koala #marsupial #wildlife #australia #nature
Wood Duck by Richard Cousens in Cumbria, UK #woodduck #duck #bird #birds #wildlife #cumbria #nature

Small Tortoiseshell (Aglais urticae): This small butterfly is native to Europe and bordering Asian regions. It has a wingspan of 6.2cm. It feeds on nectar and mutually benefits plants with pollination. #tortoiseshell #butterfly #nature #wildlife #wildlifephotography
European Red Squirrel (Sciurus vulgaris): The Head & Body length of this rodent is 23cm (9in) with its tail adding 20cm (8in). #squirrels #squirrel #redsquirrel #nature #wildlife

Keel-billed Toucan (Ramphastos sulfuratus) in Costa Rica. Photo taken by Florian Kuster. #KeelBilledToucan #toucan #bird #costarica #wildlife #nature #wildlifephotography #birds #centralamerica #americas #bsky

21 April is World Curlew Day!
Eurasian Curlew (Numenius arquata): "Couldn't believe how close this bird allowed me - she was just off a pathway on the edge of the water. Camera settings not quite right but still, it's the closest I've ever gotten" Thank you David O'Brien in Ireland. #worldcurlewday

21 April is World Curlew Day

Wildlife.net supports the Melbreak Curlew Recovery Project initiative in the UK to reverse the 60% decline in this ground nesting bird species, the Eurasian Curlew (Numenius arquata)

#curlew #curlews #worldcurlewday #nature #CurlewDay #wildlife bsky

Eurasian Jay (Garrulus glandarius): This European & Asian species of Jay is a habitual acorn horder and historically a key player in natural oak woodland regeneration. This Jay species has a harsh screeching call. Photo of a Jay taken by Jeremy Franklin in Hampshire, UK. #wildlife #eurasianjay #jay
A Peacock Pansy (Junonia almana) butterfly shows off its beautiful overwing pattern in Rajkot, Gujarat, India. Photo by Raju Karia #butterfly #peacockpansy #nature #wildlife #india
Bobcat (Lynx rufus). Thank you again Jonel Lopez for sharing this Amazing photo taken in Northern California, USA. #bobcat #cat #cats #wildlife #wildlifephotography #california #usa

Sea Turtle (superfamily Chelonioidea): Thank you to Ieva Slare of Beach4Art and your highly talented family of 4 from Devon, UK for stunning Wildlife Artwork highlighting Sustainability by using natural materials and raising funds for charity through calendars! #turtle #seaturtle #beach4art #nature

Purple Heron (Ardea purpurea) This 97cm (38in) species of Heron is found in Africa, Europe & Asia. In flight this bird retracts its neck and extends its legs beyond its tail. Mainly found around water courses, this Heron feeds on fish & amphibians. Beautiful photo taken by Jero Milan in Spain #heron

Dandelion (genus Taraxacum) are flowering plants in the family Asteraceae, which consists of species commonly known as dandelions native to Eurasia and to North America where they are enjoyed by many & considered invasive in regions of N America by some.. 🌼 #dandelion #dandelions #wildlife #nature 🌼

European Robin (Erithacus rubecula): The "Robin Redbreast" was given its nickname long before a distinction was made in the English language between "Red" & "Orange". Thank you again Matthew Cassar for sharing your lovely photo of this singing Robin taken in the UK 🎶🎵 #robin #nature #bird #wildlife

Common Chaffinch (Fringilla coelebs): This species of finch is native to North-West Africa, Europe & Asia. A 14.5cm (5.7 in) bird, it feeds its young on spiders, flies, caterpillars & aphids, outside the breeding season switching to feed on seeds & plant material, normally from the ground #chaffinch

European Robin (Erithacus rubecula): 14cm (5.5in) This is an insectivorous species that will also take seeds if put out on a bird table. Lovely close-up photo taken by Mick Williams in Lancashire, UK. #robin #redrobin #robinredbreast #europeanrobin #bird #birds #wildlife #nature

Penguins (family Spheniscidae): These are a group of aquatic flightless birds of the order Sphenisciformes. They live almost exclusively in the Southern Hemisphere: only one species, the Galápagos penguin, is found north of the Equator.🐧
#wildlife #nature #bird #birds
#Penguin #Penguins #PenguinDay

Eastern Grey (Gray) Squirrel (Sciurus carolinensis): This tree squirrel from North America plays a key role in the regeneration of the natural forest in its range which is eastern USA and Canada. Thank you Steve Berry for sharing this image of a Squirrel taken in Coventry, UK #squirrel #nature
Flamingos. Terrific photo taken by Charlotte Blanchet at Lake Burunge in Tanzania. 🦩🦩🦩🦩 #flamingo #bird #birds #flamingos #nature #wildlife #LakeBurunge #Tanzania
🦇🦇 oh yes! That is good James 🙃 Thanks @webbyjameshere.bsky.social
🦇🦇 Absolutely Liv! @livravenshawvo.bsky.social 🤎

Bats (order Chiroptera) comprise 20% of all mammal species with 1200 known types of bat. With their forelimbs adapted as wings, they are the only mammals naturally capable of true and sustained flight. Bats are more manoeuvrable than birds. #bat #bats #mammal #mammals #wildlife #nature #chiroptera 🦇

Red Kite (Milvus milvus): A distinctive large, graceful raptor with a long, forked, rusty-orange tail. Flies with easy languid wingbeats & lazy glides, circling gracefully. Thank you again Matt Trevillion for sharing your photo taken in Cambridgeshire, UK. #redkite #kite #wildlife #nature #cambridge

European Hare (Lepus europaeus): This European mammal can grow up to 75cm (30in) in length. They are also found in Asia and have been introduced into Australasia and the Americas. The fur colour is grizzled yellow-brown & rufous. Super photo of a Hare taken by David Wilcock in France. #hare #france
Chimpanzees were Jane's expertise, probably the world's expert @carolinaham.bsky.social 💚
Dr Jane Goodall.. still very much missed 💚 #jane #goodall #drjane #DrJaneGoodall
We'd have Sir David Attenborough 💚

Goldcrest (Regulus regulus): Brightly coloured crest feathers give this tiny 8.5cm (3.3in) bird its name. It is Europe's smallest bird and is also found in parts of Asia. A member of the Kinglet family. Lovely shot taken by Stephen Winfield in the UK. #goldcrest #bird #birds #wildlife #nature

Blue-footed Booby (Sula nebouxii): 90cm (35in). This Pacific seabird is easily identifiable by its bright blue webbed feet, which they use to keep their eggs warm. Their streamlined bodies make them excellent divers, & they can plummet from heights as high as 80 feet! #booby #bird #nature #wildlife

White-throated Dipper (Cinclus cinclus): This 18cm (7.1in) Aquatic passerine is not exclusive to, but can be found in Upland and Mountain areas in the Middle East, Central Asia, Europe and the Indian subcontinent. #dipper #aquatic #bird #wildlife #nature

Sharks (phylum Chordata) are an important ‘keystone species’, which means that as top predators, they are extremely important in maintaining the balance in marine ecosystems. There are well over 1,000 species of shark  🦈 #shark #sharks #ocean #wildlife #marine #fish #nature #sea #keystone
European Starling. "STARLING - Taken  in my back garden, Bridge of Don, Aberdeen, Scotland." Graeme Wilson. Terrific photo Graeme! #starling #europeanstarling #bird #birds #wildlife #nature #scotland

European Goldfinch (Carduelis carduelis): This 13cm (5.1in) species of finch is native to Europe, Asia and N. Africa. They have a distinguishing black & white head, red face and yellow bars on the wings. Wonderful photo of a Goldfinch taken by Sandy Belford in Scotland. #goldfinch #wildlife #nature
Please share your poem Stuart @stuartwhomsley.bsky.social 👍

Giraffe. "A giraffe's tongue is a remarkable tool, long (18-20 inches), dark (bluish-purple), prehensile (grasping), and tough, allowing it to navigate thorny acacia." Great fact and photo taken by Ann Warner at Mukuvisi Woodlands in Zimbabwe. #giraffe #wildlife #zimbabwe #nature🦒

Greater Bilby (Macrotis lagotis): 55cm (22in). Aka just "Bilby" this is a long-eared rabbit-like mammal native to Australia. It lives in burrows. Formerly widespread, bilbies are now endangered & with the odd exception restricted to arid parts of northwestern and central Australia. #bilby #australia
Nice photo Dan @dan-kulkosky-nyc.bsky.social and brave to be that close! 🦨

Striped Skunk (Mephitis mephitis) At up to 81cm (32in) This mammal has a range spanning most of North America. From east to west, they reach from the Atlantic to the Pacific Ocean, covering most of the continental US & southern Canada. They also range to the south over a portion of northern Mexico 🦨

European Robin. "A very friendly little chap in the hills near Dumfries. I must bring a handful of seed next time and see if he’ll eat from my hand." William Holmes in Scotland. #robin #wildlife #bird #birds #scotland #nature #wildlifephotography #bluesky
Snipe. Terrific photo taken by Jill Wilson on the Shetland Isles. #snipe #bird #birds #wildlife #nature #wildlifephotography #photography

Bengal Tiger (Panthera tigris tigris): In the past Tiger populations were monitored using identification of footprints, known as pug marks, the invention of camera traps has meant more accurate recording. Beautiful photo taken by Narendra Athnikar in Ranthambore NP, India 🐅 #tiger #wildlife #nature

—A Valentina cresceu me vendo dançar e ouvindo Shakira. Quando soube do show, ela disse: ‘Temos que ir, não podemos marcar nada nesse dia —

— É o meu primeiro show da Shakira, e estar ao lado da minha filha, que também é muito fã dela, é emocionante. Não tinha como perder, eu não me perdoaria — afirmou.

That is not a call to wait. It is a call to build with precision. You can reduce harm now while still asking what fairness means at the deepest level. Otherwise, effort chases visible problems while the deeper pattern remains untouched.

Action without that clarity becomes projection. We optimize what looks fair in the moment and miss patterns that only reveal themselves across a full life. LoF starts by defining the claim so change can rest on something firmer than intuition.

Trying to make the world fair requires facing a deeper problem: most people don’t know what fairness actually is. We recognize moments that feel unfair, but that isn’t the same as understanding the structure beneath them.

So visible inequality, even extreme inequality, does not settle that question. It describes conditions across people. LoF is about whether those conditions translate into a permanently one-sided life when taken in full. That is the distinction, and that is where the claim stands or fails.

The Law of Fairness operates at a different level. It does not evaluate whether systems look fair or whether outcomes are equal across people. It asks whether a single life, taken in full, can end in lasting imbalance in what is actually felt.

Large-scale outcomes emerge from incentives, constraints, and feedback loops. These can generate persistent inequality and real damage without a shared plan. Harm can be systemic, distributed, and reinforced over time without central direction.

Harm from power, policy, and neglect is real and serious. But moving from “harm exists” to “there is a unified intent to kill the poor” adds a claim the evidence does not support. Outcomes, even severe ones, do not by themselves establish a single coordinating motive.

So the point is not to deny hardship or flatten differences. It is to separate surface inequality from the deeper question: whether the total of what is actually felt can remain permanently imbalanced when a life is taken in full. That is the level the claim stands or fails.

What often creates the confusion is anchoring on the hardest visible segment and treating it as the whole. A life is not a snapshot under pressure. It is the full distribution of experience across time, including what is not visible or evenly weighted.

But that describes how a life feels under constraint, not how it is structured in total. Intensity across a phase, even a long one, does not by itself establish that the full trajectory ends permanently one-sided in lived experience.

Residents in Võrumaa and Ida‑Virumaa received an EE‑ALARM warning overnight about a “possible drone threat,” with authorities advising people to take cover if a drone is spotted .
Source: Postimees
#OSINT #Estonia #Airspace #DroneAlert #NordicOSINTmonitor

Võrumaalla ja Ida‑Virumaalla ihmiset saivat yöllä EE‑ALARM‑järjestelmän kautta droonivaroituksen. Viranomaiset ilmoittivat “mahdollisesta drooniuhasta” ja kehottivat hakeutumaan suojaan droonin nähdessään .
Lähde: Postimees
#OSINT #Estonia #Airspace #DroneAlert #NordicOSINTmonitor

A large overnight UAV attack hit Russia’s Leningrad region. A fire broke out at Primorsk port, and regional air defenses reportedly downed over 60 drones. Pulkovo Airport activated plan “Kover”, causing dozens of cancellations and delays.
Source: Fontanka   
#Russia#Leningrad#NordicOSINTmonitor

Leningradin alue joutui yöllä laajan drooni‑iskun kohteeksi. Primorskin satamassa syttyi tulipalo, ja alueen PVO torjui yli 60 UAV:ta. Pulkovo otti käyttöön suunnitelman “Kover”, mikä johti kymmeniin peruttuihin ja viivästyneisiin lentoihin.
Lähde: Fontanka   
#Russia #Drone#NordicOSINTmonitor

The Finnish Air Force detected a drone near the Virolahti border area overnight. It is suspected of violating Finnish airspace. The Border Guard is investigating, and a temporary airspace restriction was imposed.
Source: Iltalehti   
#OSINT #Finland #Airspace #Border #NordicOSINTmonitor

Suomen Ilmavoimat havaitsi yöllä dronen Virolahden alueella rajan tuntumassa. Lennokin epäillään loukanneen Suomen ilmatilaa ja tapausta tutkii Rajavartiolaitos. Alueelle asetettiin tilapäinen ilmailun rajoitus.
Lähde: Iltalehti   
#OSINT #Finland #Airspace #Border #NordicOSINTmonitor

St. Petersburg faced another major mobile network outage. Only government‑approved sites remained accessible as messaging apps and external services were blocked.
Source: Iltalehti, Fontanka
#OSINT #Russia #StPetersburg #Cyber #NordicOSINTmonitor

Pietarissa koettiin jälleen laaja mobiiliverkon katkos. Käytössä olivat vain viranomaisten sallimat sivustot, kun viestisovellukset ja ulkopuoliset palvelut estettiin.
Lähde: Iltalehti, Fontanka
#OSINT #Russia #Pietari #Cyber #NordicOSINTmonitor

Leningrad Oblast’s governor describes the region as a “front‑line area” following recent Ukrainian long‑range strikes. Targets have included oil and port infrastructure in Ust‑Luga and Primorsk.
Source: Kyiv Independent
#OSINT #Russia #Ukraine #BalticSea #NordicOSINTmonitor

Leningradin alueen kuvernööri kuvaa aluetta “rintamavyöhykkeeksi” Ukrainan pitkän kantaman iskujen jälkeen. Kohteena on olleet erityisesti Ust‑Lugan ja Primorskin öljy‑ ja satamainfra.
Lähde: Kyiv Independent
#OSINT #Russia #Ukraine #BalticSea #NordicOSINTmonitor
“Good addition. Exactly – provocation works only when emotion takes over. A short pause and distance restores clarity. Thank you for adding this.”

Psychological influence isn’t chaos – it’s a cycle.
Theme → target → push → silence → repeat.
Protect yourself: spot emotion‑bait, verify the source, avoid impulse sharing, don’t get provoked.
Source: Nordic OSINT Monitor
#OSINT #InfoOps #Hybrid#NordicOSINTmonitor

Psykologinen vaikuttaminen ei ole sekavaa – se on kaava.
Teema → kohde → kampanja → hiljaisuus → nosto.
Suojaudu: tunnista tunneohjaus, tarkista lähde, älä jaa impulssilla, älä provosoidu.
Lähde: Nordic OSINT Monitor
#OSINT #InfoOps #Hybrid#NordicOSINTmonitor

Steadfast Cobalt 26 Alpha brought together 700 participants from 14 Allies to test CIS interoperability. NCIA deployed ~250 experts to secure and support the mission network across locations.
Source: NCIA  
#OSINT #NATO #Cyber #CIS #Interoperability#NordicOSINTmonitor

Steadfast Cobalt 26 Alpha kokosi 700 osallistujaa 14 maasta testaamaan Naton CIS‑järjestelmien yhteentoimivuutta. NCIA tuki harjoitusta ~250 asiantuntijalla varmistaen verkkojen turvallisen ja yhtenäisen toiminnan.
Lähde: NCIA  
#OSINT #NATO #Cyber #CIS #Interoperability#NordicOSINTmonitor

OSINT signal on May 1: multiple Finland–Baltics news outlets show simultaneous access slowdowns and Cloudflare protections, while international sites remain normal. Cross‑checks indicate a regional load spike.
Source: Cloudflare, NETSCOUT
#NordicOSINTmonitor #Cyber #DDoS #Baltics#OSINT

OSINT‑havainto 1.5.Suomi–Baltia‑akselin uutismedioissa samanaikaisia saavutettavuusongelmia ja Cloudflare‑suojauksia, kun taas kansainväliset sivustot toimivat normaalisti.Ristiinvarmistus viittaa alueelliseen kuormituspiikkiin.
Source: Cloudflare, NETSCOUT
#NordicOSINTmonitor #Cyber #DDoS #Baltics

U.S. Congressman Don Bacon says the Baltic states are key to NATO security. The U.S. is increasing support as Russian military activity grows. The Baltics are seen as essential for deterrence and alliance cohesion.
Source: RFE/RL
#OSINT#Baltics#NATO#Security#NordicOSINTmonitor

Yhdysvaltain kongressiedustaja Don Bacon korostaa, että Baltian maat ovat Naton turvallisuuden kannalta avainasemassa. USA lisää tukea Venäjän kasvavan sotilaallisen toiminnan vuoksi. Baltia on pelotteen ja liittokunnan yhtenäisyyden kulmakivi.
Lähde: RFE/RL
#OSINT#Baltia#NATO#NordicOSINTmonitor

The “Karelian front” claim is part of deliberate Russian information and hybrid influence: a routine Finnish artillery exercise is framed as NATO attack preparations. The aim is to create a threat narrative and influence people.
Sources: Tass, Iltalehti
#OSINT #HybridThreats #Finland #Russia

”Karjalan rintama” ‑väite on osa Venäjän tarkoituksellista informaatio‑ ja hybridivaikuttamista: normaali suomalainen tykistöharjoitus kehystetään Naton hyökkäysvalmisteluksi. Tavoitteena luoda uhkakuvaa ja vaikuttaa ihmisiin.
Lähteet: Tass, Iltalehti
#OSINT #Hybridivaikuttaminen #Finland #Russia

Tass claims Finland is preparing a “Karelian front” with NATO. This is deliberate Russian information and hybrid influence. The exercise is a routine Finnish artillery drill with no foreign troops.
Sources: Tass, Iltalehti
#OSINT #Finland #Russia #HybridThreats #Propaganda#NordicOSINTmonitor

Tass levittää väitettä, että Suomi valmistelisi ”Karjalan rintamaa” Naton kanssa. Kyse on Venäjän tarkoituksellisesta informaatio‑ ja hybridivaikuttamisesta. Harjoitus on normaali suomalainen tykistöharjoitus ilman ulkomaisia joukkoja.
Lähteet: Tass, Iltalehti
#OSINT #Finland #Russia#Propaganda

30 April: No new military movements detected in the Baltic Sea, Kaliningrad, Murmansk or Karelia. No new drone, GPS‑jamming or cyber anomalies in the NB8 region. Background Russian activity remains structurally ongoing.
Source: OSINT monitoring  
#Security#OSINT#HybridThreats #NordicOSINTmonitor

30.4: Itämeren, Kaliningradin, Murmanskin ja Karjalan suunnalla ei havaittu uusia sotilaallisia liikkeitä. Ei myöskään uusia drone‑, GPS‑häirintä‑ tai kyberpoikkeamia NB8‑alueella. Taustalla jatkuu Venäjän rakenteellinen aktiivisuus.
Lähde: OSINT‑seuranta  
#Security #BalticSea#NordicOSINTmonitor

The Finnish Government proposes giving police the authority to intervene against drones with force, including shooting them down if necessary. The Defence Forces’ support role would expand in rapidly developing security situations.
Source: Yle  
#Finland #Security #Drones #Law #NordicOSINTmonitor

Suomen Hallitus esittää, että poliisille annetaan lupa puuttua droonien lentoon voimakeinoin, tarvittaessa myös ampumalla ne alas. Puolustusvoimien virka‑apua laajennetaan nopeasti kehittyviin turvallisuustilanteisiin.
Lähde: Yle  
#OSINT #Finland #Security #Drones #Law #NordicOSINTmonitor

Long‑time Kremlin propagandist Ilja Remeslo has turned against Putin, describing internal methods and claiming Russia faces a quiet power shift.
Source: Yle  
#OSINT #Russia #Politics #Information #HybridThreats #NordicOSINTmonitor

Pitkään Kremlin propagandistina toiminut Ilja Remeslo on kääntynyt Putinia vastaan ja kertoo sisäpiirin toimintatavoista. Hän väittää, että Venäjällä on edessä hiljainen vallanvaihto.
Lähde: Yle  
#OSINT #Russia #Politics #Information #HybridThreats #NordicOSINTmonitor

Smartphones transmit data even at night, and part of it is unrelated to device operation. Background traffic may include persistent IDs, location signals and analytics, increasing tracking and misuse risks.
Source: ETN  
#OSINT #Cyber #Privacy #Mobile #Security #NordicOSINTmonitor

Älypuhelin lähettää yölläkin dataa, josta osa ei liity laitteen toimintaan. Taustaliikenne voi sisältää pysyviä tunnisteita, sijaintisignaaleja ja analytiikkaa, jotka lisäävät seurannan ja väärinkäytön riskiä.
Lähde: ETN  
#OSINT #Cyber #Privacy #Mobile #Security #NordicOSINTmonitor

WithSecure introduces a “pre‑zero‑day” capability designed to block attack paths before a vulnerability is even known. Exploits emerge within hours, making reactive patch cycles insufficient.
Source: ETN  
#OSINT #Cyber #WithSecure #ZeroDay #Security #NordicOSINTmonitor

WithSecure esittelee “pre‑zero‑day”‑kyvykkyyden, joka pyrkii estämään hyökkäyspolut ennen kuin haavoittuvuus on edes tunnettu. Malli reagoi exploiteihin tunneissa, ei kuukausittaisissa päivityssykleissä.
Lähde: ETN  
#OSINT #Cyber #WithSecure #ZeroDay #Security #NordicOSINTmonitor

Dimitri Medvedev claims Russia has “no aggressive intentions toward Europe” and argues that European talk of inevitable war fuels tensions. The statement aligns with Russia’s spring messaging line.
Source: TASS  
#OSINT #Russia #Europe #Information #HybridThreats #NordicOSINTmonitor

Medvedev väittää, ettei Venäjällä ole “aggressiivisia aikomuksia Eurooppaa kohtaan”, ja syyttää eurooppalaista keskustelua sodan väistämättömyydestä jännitteiden kasvusta. Lausunto jatkaa Venäjän kevään viestilinjaa.
Lähde: TASS  
#OSINT#Russia #Europe #Information #HybridThreats #NordicOSINTmonitor

In April, Russian state media and European proxy outlets pushed a narrative portraying Russia as victorious and the West as weakening. The messaging appeared across multiple countries within days.
Source: Insight News Media  
#OSINT #Russia #Disinformation #Europe #HybridThreats #NordicOSINTmonitor

Huhtikuussa Venäjän valtiomedia ja eurooppalaiset proxy‑sivustot rakensivat narratiivin, jossa Venäjä esitetään voittajana ja länsi heikkona. Viestit toistuivat useissa maissa muutamassa päivässä.
Lähde: Insight News Media  
#OSINT #Russia #Disinformation #Europe #HybridThreats #NordicOSINTmonitor

Russia and its European proxy outlets pushed six coordinated narratives in April targeting the EU, Ukraine and the US. The messaging was replicated and published in Europe within hours.
Source: Insight News Media  
#OSINT #Russia #Disinformation #Europe #HybridThreats #NordicOSINTmonitor

Venäjä ja eurooppalaiset proxy‑sivustot levittivät huhtikuussa kuusi koordinoitua narratiivia EU:ta, Ukrainaa ja Yhdysvaltoja vastaan. Viestit kopioitiin ja julkaistiin Euroopassa tunneissa.
Lähde: Insight News Media  
#Russia #Disinformation#HybridThreats #NordicOSINTmonitor#Europe#OSINT

Estonia approved a legal amendment enabling allied involvement in handling “little green men”‑type hybrid scenarios, as well as supporting border security and protection of critical sites.
Source: Kaitseministeerium  
#OSINT #Estonia #Security #HybridThreats #NATO #NordicOSINTmonitor

Viron hallitus hyväksyi lakimuutoksen, joka mahdollistaa jatkossa liittolaisten osallistumisen “vihreiden miesten” kaltaisiin hybriditilanteisiin sekä rajaturvallisuuden ja kriittisten kohteiden suojaamiseen.
Lähde: Kaitseministeerium  
#Estonia #Security #HybridThreats #NATO #NordicOSINTmonitor

Estonian Defence Minister Pevkur in Helsinki: Estonia’s interest is to deepen defence cooperation with Finland. Talks focused on regional security and joint preparedness.
Source: Kaitseministeerium   
#OSINT #Estonia #Finland #Security #Defense #NordicOSINTmonitor

Viron puolustusministeri Pevkur Helsingissä: Viron etu on, että puolustusyhteistyö Suomen kanssa syvenee. Keskustelut koskivat alueellista turvallisuutta ja yhteistä varautumista.
Lähde: Kaitseministeerium   
#OSINT #Estonia #Finland #Security #Defense #NordicOSINTmonitor

Experts say talk of a Russian attack on the Baltics is overstated, with no troop build‑up visible. Risk exists, but Baltic defence and NATO presence remain strong.
Source: Postimees  
#OSINT #Baltics #Security #NATO #Russia #NordicOSINTmonitor

Asiantuntijoiden mukaan puheet Venäjän hyökkäyksestä Baltiaan ovat liioiteltuja eikä joukkokeskittymiä näy. Riski on olemassa, mutta Baltian puolustuskyky ja NATO‑läsnäolo ovat vahvat.
Lähde: Postimees  
#OSINT #Baltics #Security #NATO #Russia #NordicOSINTmonitor

The scaling‑back of the Red Square parade shows Russia cannot guarantee the event’s security. A major narrative setback: a long‑standing display of strength becomes a high‑risk target.
Source: RFE/RL  
#OSINT #Russia #Security #Moscow #VictoryDay #NordicOSINTmonitor

Punaisen torin paraatin supistaminen kertoo, ettei Venäjä pysty takaamaan tapahtuman turvallisuutta. Tämä on merkittävä narratiivitappio: vuosikymmenten voiman­näytöstä tulee riskikohde.
Lähde: RFE/RL  
#OSINT #Russia #Security #Moscow #VictoryDay #NordicOSINTmonitor

Russia is scaling back the May 9 Red Square parade: no tanks or heavy military vehicles for the first time in nearly two decades. Kremlin cites the threat of Ukrainian drone strikes.
Source: RFE/RL  
#OSINT #Russia #Moscow #VictoryDay #Security #NordicOSINTmonitor

Venäjä supistaa 9.5. Punaisen torin paraatia: ei panssarikalustoa eikä ohjuslavetteja ensimmäistä kertaa lähes 20 vuoteen. Syynä Ukrainan drone‑iskujen aiheuttama turvallisuusuhka.
Lähde: RFE/RL  
#OSINT #Russia #Moscow #VictoryDay #Security #NordicOSINTmonitor

Germany has deployed a P‑8A Poseidon to Scotland to strengthen monitoring of Russian submarine movements in the GIUK gap. The deployment enhances NATO’s situational awareness of Northern Fleet activity.
Source: Army Recognition  
#OSINT #NATO #GIUK #NorthAtlantic #JEF #NordicOSINTmonitor

Saksa on lähettänyt P‑8A Poseidon ‑merivalvontakoneen Skotlantiin vahvistamaan Venäjän sukellusveneiden liikkeiden seurantaa GIUK‑aukolla. Kyky parantaa NATO‑alueen tilannekuvaa Pohjoisen laivaston reiteistä.
Lähde: Army Recognition  
#OSINT #NATO #GIUK #NorthAtlantic #JEF #NordicOSINTmonitor

Finland’s President Alexander Stubb tells ERR that Finland was too soft on Russia before 2022. Since then, the country has shifted: NATO membership, stronger defence posture and clearer realism about the Russian threat.
Source: ERR
#OSINT #Finland #Russia #Security #NATO #NordicOSINTmonitor

Tasavallan Presidentti Alexander Stubb sanoo ERR:lle, että Suomi oli ennen 2022 liian pehmeä Venäjän suhteen. Nyt linja on koventunut: NATO‑jäsenyys, vahvempi puolustus ja selkeämpi realismi Venäjän uhasta.
Lähde ERR
#NordicOSINTmonitor #Finland #Russia #Security #NATO

Lots of poolrooms, one of the poolrooms where a unique variant with hospital green tiles and green light, backrooms variants with different colored tapestry. Drink and snack vending machines are found occasionally. more below...

text: Granted, that was over the course of 2 years, so I was spending about $100 a month, as I went along.
The game itself (not including Marketing), cost me about $3k, and most of that was 3D assets.

It is expensive for sure, if you’re going to do it solo and have to rely on purchasing your 3D assets (as I mostly did). If you can find a 3D modeler willing to collaborate for a share of the profits instead of an upfront fee, that will save a lot.
I hope to port it to consoles eventually, if I can get enough Steam sales to justify the cost.

7/7 The last, and most mysterious, of the enemies are the Wretchbounds, aka the Scarecrows. I can't say too much about the Wretchbounds without getting into spoiler territory, so I will just say that they are something of a cross between a Ghost and a Demon.
#maizegame
#horror
#videogames 
#gamelore

6/7 Demidemons, such as the Pumpkimps and Cherubs, are Demons that have been manifested into our dimension in a physical form. Because they have a physical body, they can - and will - harm you if they can catch you.
5/7 ...Demons cannot physically harm you, though when they appear they will cause you psychic damage - and the lower your sanity, the more frequently they will appear.

4/7 Demons, on the other hand, are not spirits of anyone who ever lived - though they may present themselves as such to trick their victims. Demons are entities from a parallel hellish dimension, and sometimes the veil between our dimension and theirs thins just enough for you to briefly see them...
3/7 ...The Ghosts actually work in opposition to the other dark forces at work in the maze - but that does not mean that they won't attack you if given the opportunity.

2/7 I already covered the Grave Ghosts' backstory, so won't spend too much time on them other than to say that Ghosts are, as you would expect, spirits of people (or in the case of The Hound, an animal) that were previous victims of the maze...

1/7 Still working on the music for level 4 (almost done!), so will share some more background/lore info.

There are four classes of enemies in the game: Demons (The Hat Man, Mind Hugger), Ghosts (The Hound, The Grave Ghosts), Demidemons (Pumpkimps, Cherubs), and Wretchbounds (the Scarecrows).

I genuinely believe there are those who don’t really want accountability.

Making better choices and fixing problems isn’t enough for some. It’s “too soft”.

Some are too eager to punish and shame, a spectacle and a game where every wrong is equal and forever.

The only winning move is not to play.
They tolerate each other.

It is as real as you make it to be.

embedded_title: Zsályás csirkemáj barna rizzsel, olívaolajon futtatott spárgával, rozmaringos sárgarépával és pirított gombával - egészség köntösében, karakteres ízekkel
embedded_description:
Ez a fogás egyszerre tápláló, karakteres és meglepően jól kiegyensúlyozott, ezért jó választás lehet azoknak, akik nemcsak finomat, hanem tudatosan felépített ételt is szeretnének az asztalra tenni. A kurkumás barna rizs mélyebb, tartalmasabb alapot ad, mint a finomított köretek, a zsályás csirkemáj pedig markáns, mégis jól illeszkedő fehérjeforrás. A rozmaringos sárgarépa természetes édességet hoz, a pirított gomba földes, umamis jelleget, az olívaolajon futtatott spárga pedig friss, zöld ellenpontot.




A tányér egyik fontos eleme a kurkuma és a frissen őrölt fekete bors párosa. Ez nemcsak ízben működik jól, hanem azért is érdemes együtt használni őket, mert a bors segítheti a kurkuma felszívódását. Így a barna rizs nemcsak szebb színt és melegebb aromát kap, hanem tudatosabban összeállított része lesz az egész fogásnak.


Az ilyen típusú ételek előnye, hogy valódi alapanyagokra épülnek, nem feldolgozott, túlízesített elemekre. A barna rizs, a zöldségek, a gomba, a spárga és a csirkemáj együtt olyan tányért adnak, amelyben egyszerre van jelen fehérje, rost, ásványi anyag és többféle növényi összetevő. Ez különösen fontos akkor, ha valaki hosszabb távon is fenntartható, egészségtudatos étrendben gondolkodik.


Daganatos betegségek esetén követett, kiegyensúlyozott étrendben is általában előnyös irány a több zöldség, a teljes értékű gabona, az átgondolt zsiradékhasználat és a tápanyagdús, mégsem túl nehéz fogások előtérbe helyezése.

---



Hozzávalók (2 adag)






 * 
20 dkg barna rizs


 * 
25-30 dkg csirkemáj


 * 
1 teáskanál őrölt kurkuma


 * 
frissen őrölt fekete bors


 * 
1 közepes vöröshagyma


 * 
2 gerezd fokhagyma


 * 
2 közepes sárgarépa


 * 
20 dkg csiperkegomba


 * 
8-10 szál zöld spárga


 * 
1 teáskanál szárított vagy 1 evőkanál friss rozmaring


 * 
1 teáskanál szárított vagy 5-6 friss zsályalevél


 * 
2-3 evőkanál extra szűz olívaolaj


 * 
só, ízlés szerint


 * 
kevés friss petrezselyem a tálaláshoz





---



Elkészítés






 * 
A barna rizst alaposan mosd át, majd kétszeres mennyiségű vízben tedd fel főni.


 * 
Add hozzá a kurkumát, kevés sót és bőven frissen őrölt fekete borsot, majd főzd puhára.


 * 
A sárgarépát karikázd fel, kevés olívaolajon forgasd át, add hozzá a rozmaringot, és közepes lángon süsd-pirítsd puhára.


 * 
A gombát szeleteld fel, majd serpenyőben kevés olívaolajon pirítsd le, amíg színt kap és a leve elfő.


 * 
A csirkemájat tisztítsd meg, majd papírtörlővel itasd le róla a nedvességet.


 * 
Egy serpenyőben kevés olívaolajon dinszteld meg a finomra vágott vöröshagymát és fokhagymát.


 * 
Add hozzá a csirkemájat, szórd meg zsályával, és közepes lángon süsd át, de ne szárítsd ki.


 * 
A spárgát tisztítsd meg a fás végétől, majd kevés olívaolajon röviden futtasd meg serpenyőben, hogy kissé megpiruljon, de maradjon tartása.


 * 
Tálaláskor rendezd a tányérra a kurkumás barna rizst, a zsályás csirkemájat, az olívaolajon futtatott spárgát, a rozmaringos sárgarépát és a pirított gombát.


 * 
A végén szórd meg kevés friss petrezselyemmel, és ízlés szerint még egy kevés frissen őrölt borssal fejezd be.





---



Egészségügyi előnyök






 * 
A barna rizs rostban gazdagabb, mint a finomított rizs, így kedvezőbb alapot adhat egy kiegyensúlyozottabb étrendhez.




 * 
A kurkuma és a fekete bors együtt tudatos párosítás, mert a bors segítheti a kurkuma felszívódását.




 *

Allison of Astra: The Complete First Season is now on Kickstarter as a physical NES multicart collecting all…
embedded_title: Seven NES Games, One Cartridge, One Kickstarter: Allison of Astra Is Here
embedded_description:
Seven episodes. One cartridge. A six-year-old dimension-hopper with a very loose definition of treasure.

Allison of Astra: The Complete First Season is now on Kickstarter as a physical NES multicart collecting all seven episodes of the first serialized homebrew series ever made for the Nintendo Entertainment System. Each episode drops Allison into a completely different world with its own gameplay mechanics, characters, and story beats, from a robot uprising in the island nation of Napaj to a full platformer where she teams up with a living shoe named Booty.

Peter Paltridge is a longtime PopGeeks writer, and watching him build something this ambitious from the ground up has been genuinely exciting to follow. He engineered the multicart around the rare Mapper 28 circuit board using NESMaker, compressing each game to fit within a 256kb limit without cutting content. The cart also includes Mess Maker, a creative stamp tool built from series assets, and an exclusive Season Two preview demo available only on the physical release.

Tiers start at $30 for digital ROM files and go up to $100 for the Superior Collectors Edition, which features a red cartridge, alternate cover, and a numbered certificate of authenticity styled after a Toys R Us ticket. The campaign ships worldwide with an estimated delivery of July 2026.
Try the browser-based demo before you back it. No download required, works on desktop and mobile.

Back the campaign on Kickstarter: https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1637173865/allison-of-astra-an-nes-homebrew-multicart/

Learn more about Peter Paltridge and Platypus Comix: https://www.platypuscomix.net/

embedded_description:
Back in 2012, Thermae Romae was at the top of my “must-watch” list. Like many things, it slipped into limbo—until today. Fourteen years later, and thanks to the Japanese Foundation, I finally stumbled upon it, feeling much like the protagonist: suddenly transported through time and water into a different era. At the time, I was deep into an Aya Ueto phase. Having seen her in the cult classic Azumi, I was following everything she did. In Thermae Romae, she plays an aspiring mangaka and Kenshiro superfan who becomes the guide for Lucius (Hiroshi Abe), an ancient Roman bath architect who accidentally time-travels to 21st-century Japan.   Based on Mari Yamazaki’s manga and directed by Hideki Takeuchi, the premise is wonderfully absurd: Lucius visits modern Japan to find the “lost inspiration” needed to design baths back in Rome and, inadvertently, save the Empire.   The highlights are undoubtedly the transitions between […]

ICYMI: Seven NES Games, One Cartridge, One Kickstarter: Allison of Astra Is Here: Seven episodes. One cartridge. A six-year-old dimension-hopper with a very loose definition of treasure.

Allison of Astra: The Complete First Season is now on Kickstarter as a physical NES multicart collecting all…
embedded_title: Seven NES Games, One Cartridge, One Kickstarter: Allison of Astra Is Here
embedded_description:
Seven episodes. One cartridge. A six-year-old dimension-hopper with a very loose definition of treasure.

Allison of Astra: The Complete First Season is now on Kickstarter as a physical NES multicart collecting all seven episodes of the first serialized homebrew series ever made for the Nintendo Entertainment System. Each episode drops Allison into a completely different world with its own gameplay mechanics, characters, and story beats, from a robot uprising in the island nation of Napaj to a full platformer where she teams up with a living shoe named Booty.

Peter Paltridge is a longtime PopGeeks writer, and watching him build something this ambitious from the ground up has been genuinely exciting to follow. He engineered the multicart around the rare Mapper 28 circuit board using NESMaker, compressing each game to fit within a 256kb limit without cutting content. The cart also includes Mess Maker, a creative stamp tool built from series assets, and an exclusive Season Two preview demo available only on the physical release.

Tiers start at $30 for digital ROM files and go up to $100 for the Superior Collectors Edition, which features a red cartridge, alternate cover, and a numbered certificate of authenticity styled after a Toys R Us ticket. The campaign ships worldwide with an estimated delivery of July 2026.
Try the browser-based demo before you back it. No download required, works on desktop and mobile.

Back the campaign on Kickstarter: https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1637173865/allison-of-astra-an-nes-homebrew-multicart/

Learn more about Peter Paltridge and Platypus Comix: https://www.platypuscomix.net/

Allison of Astra: The Complete First Season is now on Kickstarter as a physical NES multicart collecting all seven…
embedded_title: Seven NES Games, One Cartridge, One Kickstarter: Allison of Astra Is Here
embedded_description:
Seven episodes. One cartridge. A six-year-old dimension-hopper with a very loose definition of treasure.

Allison of Astra: The Complete First Season is now on Kickstarter as a physical NES multicart collecting all seven episodes of the first serialized homebrew series ever made for the Nintendo Entertainment System. Each episode drops Allison into a completely different world with its own gameplay mechanics, characters, and story beats, from a robot uprising in the island nation of Napaj to a full platformer where she teams up with a living shoe named Booty.

Peter Paltridge is a longtime PopGeeks writer, and watching him build something this ambitious from the ground up has been genuinely exciting to follow. He engineered the multicart around the rare Mapper 28 circuit board using NESMaker, compressing each game to fit within a 256kb limit without cutting content. The cart also includes Mess Maker, a creative stamp tool built from series assets, and an exclusive Season Two preview demo available only on the physical release.

Tiers start at $30 for digital ROM files and go up to $100 for the Superior Collectors Edition, which features a red cartridge, alternate cover, and a numbered certificate of authenticity styled after a Toys R Us ticket. The campaign ships worldwide with an estimated delivery of July 2026.
Try the browser-based demo before you back it. No download required, works on desktop and mobile.

Back the campaign on Kickstarter: https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1637173865/allison-of-astra-an-nes-homebrew-multicart/

Learn more about Peter Paltridge and Platypus Comix: https://www.platypuscomix.net/

text: FYI: best rpg for younger players: Christina and Steven say The Magical Land of Yeld is an ideal entry point for getting kids into tabletop role-playing. Steven explains that people often ask how to introduce their children to RPGs, and he calls this his go-to recommendation for adults who want to…
embedded_title: best rpg for younger players
embedded_description:
Christina and Steven say The Magical Land of Yeld is an ideal entry point for getting kids into tabletop role-playing. Steven explains that people often ask how to introduce their children to RPGs, and he calls this his go-to recommendation for adults who want to bring younger players into the hobby. He says it eases new players into core RPG roles and storytelling in a setting that feels welcoming.

They also note the game can work for adults who want to play as kids for a change, even if that isn’t where it shines most. Steven adds that the setting has a darker edge underneath the charm, which creates an interesting duality and gives older groups room to explore deeper themes. He closes by strongly recommending it for families or friends who aren’t quite ready for heavier systems like D&D or Pathfinder, but still want to learn collaborative storytelling through play.

embedded_title: DEA Clarifies That The Synthetic Cannabis Compound HHC Is Federally Banned, And Doesn’t Count As Legal Hemp
embedded_description: Federal drug officials are clarifying that a cannabinoid produced synthetically from components of the cannabis plant is federally illegal. The Drug Enforcement Administration (DEA) said that while hexahydrocannabinol (HHC) has already been considered a Schedule I illegal substance under the federal Controlled Substances Act (CSA), the agency is now giving the compound its own unique drug code for classification. HHC can be found in trace amounts in cannabis plants but is also synthesized by hydrogenating cannabidiol (CBD). It’s sometimes sprayed on cannabis flowers that are low in delta-9 THC, the most well-known psychoactive component of marijuana, and its psychoactive effects are reportedly similar.
